items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: And Steve Gadd of course went, I think Steve won, I think Steve won an audition. I remember Steve Gadd auditioned.

ctx.x: Where did you go to audition for the Mickey Mouse Club?

It was in Rochester, Sibley’s I think, it was at Sibley’s, that building upstairs on one of the floors. Jimmie Dodd came and he was one of the guys that auditioned us. And Steve Gadd of course went, I think Steve won, I think Steve won an audition. I remember Steve Gadd auditioned.
Wow. Was there any rivalry with your brothers regarding music?
